Label: GPU inference server with used NVIDIA L4 cards (new host), scaled to 1 kW
Status: variant: refurbished hardware (lever D, T-35); not the case's reference server; the reference house keeps the abstract 1 kW server of config/reference-house.json for scored figures
Description: Same build as gpu-inference-l4 (one R570-class host + 11.6 L4 cards), but the cards are bought used. The L4 is the current generation (2023), so used prices are thin and close to new; this profile isolates the GPU-price effect. Wear and failure cost: config/hardware/wear/refurbished-wear.json.
TranscriptionModel: whisper-large-v3-turbo (GPU), third-party benchmark, batch 4 (same chip as gpu-inference-l4)

UnitPurchasePriceChf.source: derived: USD 1,400 x 0.8402 CHF/USD; one completed eBay.de sale of a used L4 24 GB ('tested good', scratched; https://www.ebay.de/itm/157127945920, search snippet, accessed 2026-11-21, low: single sale, date unclear). Used asking price seen: USD 2,898 (https://www.ebay.com/itm/236238919558), i.e. above the new Bechtle price CHF 2,235

HostElectricKw.source: same estimate as config/hardware/cpu-server.json UnitElectricKw (Xeon 6507P TDP + memory)

HostPurchasePriceChf.source: data/raw/market/costs.csv cost-server-dell-r570 (new host kept on purpose, to isolate the GPU effect)

ServerElectricKw.source: docs/case/challenge.md: rack-server reference (1 kW), used as normalisation

IdleElectricKw.source: TODO(source): idle draw of L4 cards and host not sourced (as gpu-inference-l4)

HeatRecoveryShare.source: docs/case/challenge.md: 80 percent recoverable into water (assumes liquid cooling; L4 cards are passively air-cooled)

LifetimeYears.source: derived: value-weighted life so that purchase / life = cards / 3 years + host / 6 years = 13682.42 / 3 + 8248.03 / 6 = CHF 5935.48 per year; 3 years remaining for used cards (assumption, docs/research/refurbished-hardware.md §4), 6 years for the new host (data/raw/market/costs.csv lifetime-coreweave-technology-accounting)

OpsChfPerServerYear.source: derived: 1 host x CHF 59 per server-month x 12 (data/raw/market/costs.csv cost-ops-smartsolution-server-basic); expected failure cost NOT included, see config/hardware/wear/refurbished-wear.json

TranscriptionAudioHoursPerServerHour.source: derived: as gpu-inference-l4 (11.6313 x 40.4, low); same chip, no throughput loss with age assumed (assumption: silicon ageing is not a measurable throughput loss for a cooled card, TODO(source))

LlmTokensPerServerHour.source: derived: as gpu-inference-l4 (docs/research/l4-throughput.md section 2, 25 M, range 17-120 M); same chip, no throughput loss with age assumed (as TranscriptionAudioHoursPerServerHour, TODO(source))

WebhostingSitesPerServer.source: TODO(source): GPUs add nothing to webhosting; host CPU only

SpotPriceChfPerServerHour.source: derived: as gpu-inference-l4: 11.6313 x CHF 0.1914 AWS g6.xlarge spot eu-central-2 (cp-gpu-aws-g6-xlarge-euc2-spot, medium); buyers do not see the card's age

OnDemandPriceChfPerServerHour.source: derived: as gpu-inference-l4: 11.6313 x CHF 0.9116 (cp-gpu-aws-g6-xlarge-euc2-od, high)

HomeHostPriceChfPerServerHour.source: derived: as gpu-inference-l4: 11.6313 x CHF 0.3697 RunPod L4 community (cp-mkt-runpod-l4-community, high)
